Based on my analysis of the a11y-webring.club repository commit history on GitLab, I found:

1. There are NO commits on February 6, 2023 (2/6/2023) in this repository.
2. The visible commit dates in February 2023 are: February 4, 2023 (9 commits) and February 2, 2023 (1 commit).
3. I found a commit by 'Steve Woodson' (not 'Steven Woodson') on February 2, 2023 for the change: '#60: Added sorting by manually entered date field in each member JSON file'.
4. When searching for 'Steven Woodson', I found 2 commits that mention his name in the commit message but are authored by Eric Bailey (not Steven Woodson).

Conclusion: Steven Woodson made ZERO commits to a11y-webring.club on 2/6/2023. There were no commits at all on that date in the repository.
